implementation.upgrade: provider-neutral checkpoint receipts bind objective state, execution generation, lease identity, trace digest, state/world/resource digests, event sequence, predecessor digest, freshness, and replay-safe resume admission

research_inputs.finding: Current LangGraph documentation describes low-level orchestration for long-running stateful agents with persistence, checkpoints, stores, fault tolerance, event streaming, interrupts, time travel, memory, testing, and human-in-the-loop controls.
research_inputs.used_for: checkpoint state versioning and explicit recovery-admission boundaries

research_inputs.finding: Temporal describes durable execution through event sourcing and state management, recording workflow and activity history and returned values so a restarted process can recreate state and resume.
research_inputs.used_for: event sequence, predecessor digest, restart verification, and deterministic resume design

research_inputs.finding: vLLM documents persistent inference runtime concerns including cache management, continuous batching, disaggregated execution, and broad model/accelerator support.
research_inputs.used_for: provider-neutral checkpoint state and resource-digest fields without importing engine authority

research_inputs.finding: Anthropic documents versioned computer-use runtimes, isolated environments, minimal privileges, human confirmation, prompt-injection limitations, and action-loop verification.
research_inputs.used_for: explicit non-authority and caller-policy requirements for recovery and side effects

limitations: The contract records and verifies checkpoint evidence but does not perform storage replication, distributed consensus, migration, or actual task execution.
Checkpoint digests and lease identity are caller-supplied and are not hardware-attested or independently signed in this local implementation.
Resume admission is a control-plane decision record; it is not execution permission and requires a separate caller policy and execution engine.
The benchmark measures local Python control-plane overhead and excludes storage, network, kernel, model, accelerator, and crash-recovery latency.
This evidence does not claim AGI, production approval, physical hardware qualification, independent builder qualification, or independent external review.
